market_question: Will Arsenal finish in 2nd place in the 2025-26 English Premier League?
reasoning: Arsenal have finished exactly 2nd in each of the last two Premier League seasons (2022–23, 2023–24) and, under Mikel Arteta, possess a deep, young squad that should remain highly competitive. With Manchester City still a strong favourite for the title, a repeat of 2nd place is a realistic central scenario. Assigning a 25% chance to finishing exactly 2nd seems reasonable, making the 17.5% market price an undervaluation.
evidence_points: Consistent top-4 finishes under Arteta with a settled tactical system.
Squad depth and young core (Saka, Ødegaard, Saliba) suggest sustained high-level performance.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of Arsenal squad and recent transfer activity
